given_when_then.given: A Delivery Partner has completed a physical handover and is ready to submit proof
given_when_then.when: The Delivery Partner captures a digital signature
given_when_then.then: The system validates the proof and releases funds to the Store Partner

given_when_then.given: A Delivery Partner has completed a physical handover and is ready to submit proof
given_when_then.when: The Delivery Partner captures a timestamped photo
given_when_then.then: The system validates the proof and releases funds to the Store Partner

given_when_then.given: A Delivery Partner has completed a physical handover and is ready to submit proof
given_when_then.when: The Delivery Partner captures an automated confirmation code
given_when_then.then: The system validates the proof and releases funds to the Store Partner

given_when_then.given: A Delivery Partner has completed a physical handover and is ready to submit proof
given_when_then.when: The system attempts to retrieve external proof that is invalid or missing
given_when_then.then: The system creates a Dispute Ticket and blocks fund release

given_when_then.given: A delivery proof lacks a timestamp or valid signature
given_when_then.when: The Delivery Partner attempts to submit the proof
given_when_then.then: The system creates a Dispute Ticket

given_when_then.given: The associated Delivery Assignment is marked as cancelled
given_when_then.when: The Delivery Partner attempts to capture or submit delivery proof
given_when_then.then: The system rejects the delivery proof

success_criteria: The system allows a Delivery Partner to capture a digital signature, timestamped photo, or automated confirmation code upon handover.
The system treats proof retrieved via external API with the same verification standards as locally captured proof.
Funds are not released until a valid delivery proof is recorded in the system.
A Dispute Ticket is created if the delivery proof lacks a timestamp or valid signature.
The system rejects delivery proof if the associated Delivery Assignment is marked as cancelled.
